paths.name: Path of The Hunter
paths.description: A Mastery path focused on both you and your pet equally.

ability.name: Lionheart
ability.description: Lion's Fury no longer requires that the target be Cursed, costs 15 fewer action points, and deals 434 Spirit damage.

ability.name: Echoing Roar
ability.description: You and your War Lion each unleash a blasting shout, interrupting any enemies within 25 feet of either one of you and inflicting an Ailment which causes 525 Spirit damage over 15 seconds to all affected enemies.

ability.name: Pack Hunting
ability.description: Increase the chance to apply Hunter's Strike from Trained To Hunt by 10%. All group members within 100 feet can now apply Hunter's Strike.

ability.name: Force Opportunity
ability.description: You strike at your enemy with a brutal attack which causes 246 damage and can not be defended against. The victim's armor is reduced by 1600 for the next 10 seconds.

ability.name: Hack And Slash
ability.description: Reduces the action point costs of Slashing Blade and Hack by 15 AP, and increases the armor penetration of Slashing Blade and Whirling Axe by 15%.

ability.name: Whirling Axe
ability.description: You rapidly spin your axe around for up to 3 seconds, dealing 184 damage every second to all enemies within 25 feet.  This ability will end if you lose your concentration or run out of action points.

ability.name: Blade And Claw
ability.description: Deals 1200 damage to all enemies within 25 feet of both you and your War Lion.

coreAbilities.name: Coordinated Strike
coreAbilities.description: You and your War Lion attack as a pack, ravaging your enemies.  You strike your target for 134 damage, and your pet strikes its target for 134 damage.  If you are within 35 feet of your pet's target, you will also strike that enemy for 134 damage, and likewise, if your pet is within 35 feet of your target, it will also strike your enemy for 134 damage as well.

coreAbilities.name: Hack
coreAbilities.description: A brutal chop at your enemy which deals 284 damage. Your War Lion's next ability within 10 seconds will automatically critically hit.

coreAbilities.name: Lion's Fury
coreAbilities.description: You draw upon your mystical Elven heritage and furiously attack your target, dealing 246 Spirit damage.

coreAbilities.name: Trained To Hunt
coreAbilities.description:
You train your pet to hunt with you, increasing its Strength, Toughness, Wounds, and Weapon Skill by 50% of your bonus gained from items.  Any time either you or your War Lion strikes an enemy, there is a 10% chance that you will deal an additional 393 damage over 3 seconds.

Your War Lion will gain the ability to bite its enemies, the ability to claw at multiple foes, and the ability to reduce several enemies' autoattack speeds.

coreAbilities.name: Slashing Blade
coreAbilities.description: A broad sweep of your axe which deals 184 damage to all enemies in front of you, up to 25 feet away.

paths.name: Path of The Axeman
paths.description: A Mastery path focused on your pet distracting enemies while you deal damage.

ability.name: Blindsided!
ability.description: Blindside will now also disorient your victim for 10 seconds, causing all of their abilities to take an additional 50% to build up.

ability.name: Primal Fury
ability.description:
For the next 10 seconds, you will deal 25% more damage.
Does not affect damage procs.

ability.name: Threatening Distraction
ability.description: Fey Illusion will now also increase your chance to critically hit by 15% for 10 seconds.

ability.name: Cull The Weak
ability.description: A ruthless attack which deals 414 damage and will almost always deal critical damage to a wounded foe. If this ability lands a killing blow, Cull The Weak and your War Lion's cooldowns will be reset.

ability.name: Mane-Cutter’s Momentum
ability.description: Whenever you hit an enemy from the side or rear, your Auto Attack speed is increased by 50% for 5 seconds.

ability.name: Thin The Herd
ability.note: Must be at your target's side or rear
ability.description: You call forth a small bit of power as you attack your enemy, dealing 284 damage and causing all healing that they use within the next 10 seconds to become 50% as effective.

ability.name: Joy of the Hunt
ability.description: Your War Lion is fully healed, and all group members within 100 feet instantly gain 250 Action Points.

coreAbilities.name: Sundering Chop
coreAbilities.description: A powerful axe chop which deals 209 damage. If behind your target, ignores 15% of the victim's armor.

coreAbilities.name: Blindside
coreAbilities.note: Must be at your target's side or rear
coreAbilities.description: You attack your enemy at a vulnerable spot, dealing 141 damage immediately and inflicting them with an Ailment which deals an additional 366 damage over 9 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Trained To Threaten
coreAbilities.description:
You train your pet to behave menacingly, increasing its Toughness and Wounds by your Toughness and Wounds gained from items and increasing your chance to critically hit by 5% as long as you are at your target's sides or back.

Your War Lion will gain the ability to threaten its enemies, the ability to reduce a foe's armor, and the ability to snare its enemies.

coreAbilities.name: Shattering Blow
coreAbilities.description: A powerful attack which shatters your enemy's bones, inflicting a Curse which deals 558 damage over 9 seconds.  If you attack an enemy from the sides or back, then you will also reduce their Strength by 150 for 9 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Fey Illusion
coreAbilities.description: You invoke a minor bit of Elven power and attack your target with a befuddling strike, dealing 284 damage. The enemies attack speed is reduced by 20% for the next 10 seconds.  Enemy monsters will become confused and will believe that your selected groupmate, or your War Lion if you do not have one, struck the blow.

paths.name: Path of The Guardian
paths.description: A Mastery path focused on assisting and supporting your pet while he deals damage.

ability.name: Bonded Pack
ability.description: You gain an additional 50 Morale every 5 seconds as long as you have an active War Lion. Any time you or one of your groupmates damages an enemy with Pack Assault they will gain 100 Morale.

ability.name: Throat Bite
ability.description: You command your pet to go for the throat!  Your War Lion's next attack within 5 seconds will deal an additional 187 damage and will Silence its victim, making them unable to use magic for 4 seconds.

ability.name: Furious Mending
ability.description: The healing from Nature's Bond now also affects group members within 25 feet of your War Lion

ability.name: Brutal Pounce
ability.description: You command your pet to attack without mercy!  Your War Lion's next attack within 5 seconds will deal an additional 225 damage and will knock down its victim for 3 seconds.

ability.name: Baited Trap
ability.description: Baiting Strike will now also increase your chance to disrupt spells by 10% for 15 seconds, and increase your armor by 594.

ability.name: Leonine Frenzy
ability.description:
At your command, your War Lion goes berserk with a killing frenzy!  All root and snare are removed from your pet, and it becomes immune to them for the next 10 seconds.  During this time, your pet will deal an additional 209 damage every time it strikes an enemy.
Damage can only trigger once every 0.5 seconds and cannot crit.

ability.name: Rampage
ability.description: For the next 10 seconds, all of your abilities will cool down immediately and not cost any action points.  This will also affect your War Lion as well.

coreAbilities.name: Baiting Strike
coreAbilities.description: An attack which momentarily distracts your enemy, dealing 171 damage to them.  Your targeted groupmate, or your War Lion if you do not have one, will cause 25% less hatred in all enemy monsters for 5 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Trained To Kill
coreAbilities.description:
You train your pet to fight ferociously, increasing its Strength and Weapon Skill by your Strength and Weapon Skill gained from items and increasing your Toughness by 100.

Your War Lion will gain the ability to strike its enemies with a powerful mauling attack, the ability to attack its target repeatedly, and the ability to deal damage over time.

coreAbilities.name: Cleave Limb
coreAbilities.description: A sundering blow which deals 171 damage and inflicts your victim with an Ailment which reduces their movement speed by 40% for 5 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Pack Assault
coreAbilities.description: A feral attack which deals 209 damage and inspires your groupmates to hunt as a pack.  Within the next 5 seconds, each group member within 100 feet will deal an additional 150 damage with their next attack.

coreAbilities.name: Pounce
coreAbilities.note:
You cannot perform this action while rooted
You cannot perform this action while airborne
coreAbilities.description: You pounce forwards, leaping towards your target and causing 171 damage when you land. Your movement speed will subsequently be increased by 35% for 3 seconds. This speed increase will be dismissed if you use any ability.

coreAbilities.name: Bypass Defenses
coreAbilities.description: You bolster yourself for 10 seconds, allowing you to bypass the defenses of an enemy keep's postern door, porting you inside.

coreAbilities.name: Siege Wrecker
coreAbilities.description: You sabotage a siege ram, causing the ram to deal 98% of the original damage for the next 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Faultfinder
coreAbilities.description: Increases friendly ram damage by 2% for the next 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Axe Toss
coreAbilities.description: You fling a throwing axe at your target, dealing 81 damage.

coreAbilities.name: Call War Lion
coreAbilities.description:
You call your tamed War Lion to come forth and fight with you.
You may only have a single War Lion at a time.

coreAbilities.name: Flee
coreAbilities.description: You run away from the battle in a mad panic, increasing your run speed by 30% for 10 seconds.  You immediately lose all of your action points, any career mechanic points, and your Morale will begin to drop, and you will not begin to regain action points until 10 seconds have passed.

coreAbilities.name: Charge!
coreAbilities.description: You and your War Lion charge into the thick of battle, increasing your movement speed by 50 for 7 seconds.  If you or your War Lion use any abilities, this effect will immediately end.

coreAbilities.name: Nature's Bond
coreAbilities.description: You empower the bond between yourself and your War Lion, making it immune to damage for 2 seconds. Your War Lion then regains 1350 health over 5 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Submission
coreAbilities.description:
You cower submissively, causing all enemies within 30 feet to hate you less and deal only 50% damage to you for 5 seconds.  For the next 5 seconds, you will cause 25% less hate in all enemy monsters. You will also deal 50% damage to them until the effect is broken.
If you attack anyone that you've Detaunted, the effect will immediately fade from them.

coreAbilities.name: Sever Nerve
coreAbilities.description: A directed strike that inflicts 1200 damage to your target.

coreAbilities.name: Centuries of Training
coreAbilities.description: Upon striking a target with direct damage there is a 25% chance to inflict an additional 303 Spirit damage over 3 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Feline Grace
coreAbilities.description: Your training and Elven grace allows you to remove all roots and snares from yourself and your War Lion.  For the next 10 seconds, roots and snares will have no effect on you or your War Lion.

coreAbilities.name: Force of Will
coreAbilities.description: You stare down your opponent, draining 200 of their Action Points into yourself, and reducing their Strength by 160 for 30 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Jagged Edge
coreAbilities.description: Any time you critically hit an enemy they will begin to bleed, suffering additional 507 Corporeal damage over 9 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Pack Synergy
coreAbilities.description: Increases the additional damage dealt when either you or your pet critically hits by 50%, as long as you have a pet active.

coreAbilities.name: Brute Force
coreAbilities.description: Increases your Strength by 160.

coreAbilities.name: Confusing Movements
coreAbilities.description: Concentrating on your perceived movements, you will be able to Dodge and Parry all attacks against you for 7 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Bend the Winds
coreAbilities.description: Increases your Elemental resistance by 252.

coreAbilities.name: Relentless Assault
coreAbilities.description: A prolonged fervor that grants 10 Action Points a second to everyone in your group within 100 feet of you for 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Speed Training
coreAbilities.description: Increases your War Lion's movement speed by 50%.

coreAbilities.name: Discerning Offense
coreAbilities.description: Your attacks have a 10% reduced chance to be defended against.

coreAbilities.name: Overpowering Blow
coreAbilities.description: You strike your opponent with surprising force, dealing 1200 damage and knocking them down for 4 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Flanking
coreAbilities.description:
All of your attacks deal 15% more damage when you strike an enemy from the sides or rear.
Does not affect damage procs.

coreAbilities.name: Close Combat
coreAbilities.description: Any time you strike an enemy in melee with a direct attack, you will receive 25% less damage from ranged and magical attacks for 2 seconds. This effect will not guard or detaunt abilities.

coreAbilities.name: Flashing Claws
coreAbilities.description: Increases the chance to parry attacks by 10% for both you and your pet, as long as you have a pet active.

coreAbilities.name: Ensnare
coreAbilities.description: Deals 900 damage to your target, and roots them in place for 5 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Riposte
coreAbilities.description: Each time you parry an enemy's attack, you will strike them back for 246 damage which they can not prevent.

coreAbilities.name: Revenge!
coreAbilities.description:
If your War Lion is killed, you will go into a rage and deal 50% more damage for 10 seconds.
Does not affect damage procs.

coreAbilities.name: Flying Axe
coreAbilities.description: Deals 1200 damage to all enemies in a line in front of you, up to 65 feet away.

coreAbilities.name: Loner
coreAbilities.description:
You deal 25% more damage, but you are unable to call forth your War Lion, and it will depart if it has already been summoned.
Does not affect damage procs.

coreAbilities.name: Dominance
coreAbilities.description: Deals 1800 damage to your target, and heals you for 50% of the damage done.

coreAbilities.name: Tearing Blade
coreAbilities.description: Slashing Blade and Sundering Chop will now cause an additional 258 damage over 3 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Fetch!
coreAbilities.description: You command your War Lion to toss its target through the air, knocking them closer to you. On successful knock, your War Lion’s movement speed is increased by 30% for 2 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Frenzied Slaughter
coreAbilities.description: All of your abilities will cost 25% fewer action points, cool down 50% faster, and deal 20% more damage for 7 seconds.
